remarks: Welcome home to this peaceful top-floor corner retreat, where a private deck overlooks a serene wooded backdrop with best views the complex has to offer. Bathed in natural light, this bright and airy residence offers an inviting open-concept layout, centered around a cozy wood-burning fireplace-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Brand-new wall-to-wall carpeting and a completely new paint job of the entire unit gives a refreshed sense throughout. The full ensemble of kitchen appliaces surrounded by oak cabinets make the kitchen a delight to spend time in. This unit offer two full bathrooms. The entire heating and airconditioning system was replaced just two months ago. The washing machine/dryer unit is newer and located within the unit. An additional feature includes an under-house spacious storage room with interior access, and two assigned parking spaces. Ideally situated for commuters, this home is within walking distance to public bus lines and the Metro-North train station at Merritt 7. Enjoy the best of Norwalk living with nearby beaches, dining, and a wide range of recreational opportunities. Offering the perfect balance of comfort, convenience, and charm-this is an opportunity you won't want to miss!  There is also a spacious storage room specifically allocated to this unit, located in the basement.
